spans.s:
नंश् नंश्, the base of many forms of rt.
2. नश्, q. v.

नंश, अस्, m. (?), Ved. (according to Sāy.) =
नाशन, removal, removing, destruction; (but per-
haps fr. rt. 1. नश्), acquisition.

नंशन, अम्, n. (?), destruction, in स्वप्न-न्˚,
q. v.

नंशुक, अस्, ई, अम्, injurious, destructive; going
astray, being lost; small, minute.

नंष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, destructible, to be injured
or killed.

नंष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, a destroyer, destructive;
perishing, being lost.

ननन्दृ ननन्दृ or ननान्दृ, आ, f. (said to
be fr. rt. नन्द्), a husband's sister, a sister-in-law.
—ननान्दृ-पति or ननान्दुः-पति, इस्, m. the
husband of a husband's sister.

नना नना, f., Ved. a familiar expression
for ‘mother,’ corresponding to तत, q. v.; (according
to the Naighaṇṭuka
) = वाच्, speech.
नान नान, अस्, m., N. of a man.

नाना नाना, ind. (probably a reduplication
of the negative particle न or of the pronominal
affix न in अ-न &c.), in different or various ways,
in different places, manifoldly, differently, variously;
distinctly, separately; (when used as an adj. at the
beginning of a comp. = ) of different kinds, of dif-
ferent classes, various, sundry, different, manifold,
diverse; (according to Pāṇ.

) = विना, without
(with gen., abl., inst.).
—नाना-कन्द, अस्, m. a
species of bulbous plant (= पिण्डालु).
—नानाकार
(˚ना-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, of different forms or manifold
kinds, multiform, various.
—नाना-कारम्, ind. hav-
ing done variously.
—नाना-ग्रह, अस्, m. taking
separately, (used to explain अव-ग्रह.)
—नाना-
जातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, of various kinds or sorts, belonging
to different classes, &c.
—नानात्म-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
maintaining the Sāṅkhya doctrine that each individual
being has a soul distinct from the universal spirit.
—नानात्यय (˚ना-अत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, of different
kinds, manifold.
—नाना-त्व, अम्, n. variety, diver-
sity, difference, manifoldness, (opposed to एक-त्व,
ऐक्य.)
—नाना-दानानि, n. pl. ‘various presents,’
N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva.
—नाना-
देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or coming from
different districts or countries.
—नाना-धर्मन्,
आ, आ, अ, Ved. having different customs or character-
istics.
—नाना-धातु-शत, अम्, n. a hundred various
[]
minerals.
—नानाधातु-समाकीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्,
filled with various minerals.
—नाना-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ,
Ved. having different intentions.
—नाना-ध्वनि,
इस्, m. a musical instrument of more than one tone.
—नाना-नाम-निरूपण, अम्, n., N. of the tenth
chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa.
—नाना-पक्षि-गणाकीर्ण (˚ण-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
filled with flocks of various birds.
—नानापक्षि-
निषेवित, अस्, आ, अम्, frequented by various birds.
—नाना-पद, अम्, n., Ved. a different or separate
or independent word.
—नानापद-स्थ, अस्, m.,
Ved. (an accent) standing on distinct words or on a
separate word (?).
—नाना-प्रभृति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved.
beginning differently, (opposed to नानोदर्क.)
—नाना-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of the great-grandfather
of Raṅga-nātha, a commentator on Kāli-dāsa's Vikra-
morvaśī.
—नाना-मृग-गण, आस्, m. pl. flocks of
various animals.
—नाना-रथम्, ind., Ved. in
many chariots, in various cars.
—नाना-रस, अस्, आ,
अम्, of different flavours, variously flavoured.
—नाना-
राग, अस्, आ, अम्, variegated, of many colours.
—नाना-रूप, आणि, n. pl. various forms, different
shapes; (अस्, आ, अम्), of different forms or shapes,
of various kinds, multiform, various.
—नानारूप-
ता, f., Ved. multiformity, diversity of form, various-
ness.
—नानार्थ (˚ना-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a
different aim or object, containing something else
(as a new sentence or thing); having different mean-
ings (as a word).
—नानार्थ-कोष, अस्, m. a
dictionary which contains words with different mean-
ings.
—नानार्थ-ध्वनि-मञ्जरी, f. ‘a cluster or
nosegay of words with different meanings,’ N. of a
dictionary by an anonymous author.
—नानार्थ-रत्-
न-तिलक, N. of a dictionary, = अनेकार्थ-तिलक.
—नानार्थरत्न-माला, f. ‘necklace of words of
different meanings,’ N. of a glossary.
—नानार्थ-
सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘collection of words with dif-
ferent meanings,’ N. of a dictionary by Ajaya-pāla.
—नाना-वर्ण, आस्, m. pl. different colours; (अस्,
आ, अम्), many-coloured, variegated.
—नाना-विध,
अस्, आ, अम्, of various sorts, of sundry kinds, in
various ways, multiform, manifold.
—नाना-वीर्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, having different effects, having manifold
efficacy.
—नानावीर्य-ता, f., Ved. the state of having
manifold efficacy.
—नाना-सूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
illuminated by different suns.

ननु न-नु, ind. (fr. 2. न + नु), a strong
negative particle = ‘not at all’ (Ved.); a particle of
interrogation = the Latin नोन्ने, ‘not?’ ‘is not?’
‘are not?’ ‘does he not?’ often a particle of affir-
mation = ‘is it not so?’ i. e. ‘it certainly must be
so,’ hence = ‘certainly,’ ‘assuredly,’ or with an impe-
rative = ‘pray,’ ‘do,’ ‘just,’ ‘well,’ ‘do now,’ &c., or
sometimes with an interrogative pronoun (e. g. ननु
को भवान्, pray who art thou?); in argumentative
writings often a mere inceptive particle = ‘now then,’
‘but then,’ ‘but’ (e. g. ननु न किञ्चिन् मानम्
इति चेन्

न, now if it be said that there is no proof,
not so); नन्व् अस्तु तथापि, ‘well, be it so, never-
theless;’ ननु च, ‘and (is it) not so?’ ‘is not then?’
‘there can be no doubt.’ According to native lexi-
cographers ननु is also a vocative particle = ‘ho,’
‘hallo;’ a particle implying kindness, conciliation, &c.,
= ‘pray,’ ‘good friend;’ a responsive particle; a parti-
cle of reproach, perplexity, &c.
नानू नानू, ऊस्, m., N. of a man.

नन्तृ नन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. rt. नम्), bend-
ing, bowing, stooping; (in grammar) Ved. changing
a dental to a cerebral.

नन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be bent or bowed, to
be saluted, to be revered or honoured.

नन्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be bent or bowed,
to be humbled.

नन्द् नन्द् (thought by some to be for
ननद्, a reduplicated form of rt. नद्, to
utter sounds of approbation; the intial न् is never
cerebralized), cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) नन्दति (-ते),
ननन्द, नन्दिष्यति, अनन्दीत्, नन्दितुम्, to
be pleased or satisfied with, to be contented with, be
glad of anything (with inst., rarely abl.): Caus. नन्-
दयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अननन्दत्, to make glad,
gladden: Desid. निनन्दिषति: Intens. नानन्द्-
यते, नानन्ति.

नन्द, अस्, m. happiness, pleasure, joy, felicity,
prosperity; a flute eleven inches long; N. of one
of the two drums of Yudhi-ṣṭhira; of one of the
nine inestimable gems or treasures of Kuvera; an
epithet of Viṣṇu; N. of one of Skanda's attendants;
of a Buddhist deity, (also read नन्दन); of a
Nāga [cf. नन्दक]; of a Nāga-rāja; of an attend-
ant on Dakṣa; of a son of king Dhṛta-rāṣṭra [cf.
नन्दक]; of a brother of Śākya-muni [cf. नन्-
दक]; of a son of Vasu-deva; of a cowherd who
was the foster-father of Kṛṣṇa and apparently also
of Durgā; of a leader of the Sātvatas; of a king of
Pāṭali-putra, cut off by the machinations of Candra-
gupta's minister Cāṇakya, and founder of the Nanda
dynasty; of a Buddhist writer on law [cf. नन्द-
पण्डित]; of a mountain [cf. नन्दि-गिरि]; (आ),
f. Delight, Felicity (personified as the wife of Har-
sha, cf. नन्दि), prosperity, happiness, joy; a small
earthen water-jar [cf. नन्दिका]; a husband's sister
[cf. ननान्दृ]; N. of one of the seven or five small
Kumārīs or staffs of Indra's standard, (according to
a commentator नन्दा and उप-नन्दा); the first,
[]
sixth, or eleventh day of the fortnight, considered as
three auspicious Tithis [cf. नन्दिका]; an epithet of
Gaurī; a form of Dākṣāyaṇī; N. of an Apsaras,
(also read काम्या); of the eldest daughter of Vi-
bhīṣaṇa; N. of a girl connected with Śākya-muni,
(also read नन्दी); of the mother of the tenth Arhat
of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; N. of a wife of Gopāla-
varman; of a river flowing near Kuvera's city Alakā,
(often mentioned with अपर-नन्दा; cf. नन्दा-
तीर्थ); (ई), f. the tree Cedrela Toona [cf. नन्दी-
वृक्ष]; an epithet of Durgā; N. of Indra's resi-
dence, = अमरा-वती; [cf. आ-न्˚, अलक-न्˚, गो-न्˚.]
—नन्द-किशोर, अस्, m., N. of the author of a
supplement to Vopa-deva's Mugdha-bodha.
—नन्द-
गोप, अस्, m. the cowherd Nanda.
—नन्दगोप-
कुमार, अस्, m. ‘son of the cowherd Nanda,’ epi-
thet of Kṛṣṇa.
—नन्द-गोपिता, f., N. of a plant,
see रास्ना.
—नन्द-नन्दन, अस्, m. ‘the foster-
son of the cowherd Nanda,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
—नन्द-नन्दनी, f. ‘daughter of the cowherd
Nanda,’ epithet of Durgā.
—नन्द-पण्डित, अस्,
m., N. of a writer on jurisprudence.
—नन्द-पद्र,
N. of a town.
—नन्द-पाल, अस्, m. ‘guardian of
the treasure Nanda,’ epithet of Varuṇa.
—नन्द-
पुत्री, f. ‘daughter of the cowherd Nanda,’ epithet
of Durgā.
—नन्द-पुत्रोत्सव (˚र-उत्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of the ninth chapter of the Kṛṣṇa-khaṇḍa or
fourth part of the Brahma-vaivarta-Purāṇa.
—नन्द-
प्रयाग, अस्, m., N. of a place mentioned in the
Rasika-ramaṇa by Raghu-nātha (at the confluence
of two rivers containing the word नन्द in their
names).
—नन्द-बला, f., N. of a girl connected
with Śākya-muni.
—नन्द-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a
man.
—नन्द-वर्धन, अस्, m. ‘joy-increaser,’
N. of a poet mentioned in the Śārṅgadhara-pad-
dhati.
—नन्द-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of an author.
—नन्दा-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha (the river
Nandā?).
—नन्दात्मज (˚द-आत्˚), अस्, m. ‘son of
the cowherd Nanda,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa; (आ), f.
‘daughter of the cowherd Nanda,’ epithet of Durgā.
—नन्दा-पुराण, अम्, n. ‘the Purāṇa treating of
Nandā,’ N. of an Upa-Purāṇa.
—नन्दा-प्राची-
माहात्म्य, अम्, n., N. of the eighteenth chapter
of the Sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍa or first part of the Padma-
Purāṇa.
—नन्दाश्रम (˚द-आश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a
hermitage.
—नन्दा-ह्रद-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
sacred bathing-place.
—नन्दी-पुर, अम्, n., N. of
a town mentioned in the Kathārṇava.
—नन्दी-
वृक्ष, अस्, m., N. of several plants, = नन्दि-
वृक्ष, Cedrela Toona; = मेष-श्रिङ्गी, Thespe-
sia Populneoides; = स्थाली.
—नन्दी-सरस्, अस्, n.,
N. of Indra's lake.

नान्द नान्द, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नन्द), relating
to Nanda.

नन्दक, अस्, आ, अम्, rejoicing, making happy or
glad, causing pleasure, gladdening; rejoicing or de-
lighting in; rejoicing a family; joyful; (अस्), m.
a frog (= नन्दन); N. of Kṛṣṇa's sword; of a
Nāga [cf. नन्द]; of one of Skanda's attendants;
of a son of king Dhṛta-rāṣṭra [cf. नन्द]; of a
Śākya [cf. नन्द]; of a bull; of a village; (ac-
cording to some also) happiness, pleasure (= आनन्द);
N. of the foster-father of Kṛṣṇa, = नन्द; (इका),
f. a small water-jar [cf. नन्दा]; N. of three auspi-
cious Tithis, the first, sixth, and eleventh, (according
to the Tithi-tattva) the sixth Tithi [cf. नन्दा]; N.
of Indra's pleasure-ground.
नन्दकि, इस्, m. (fr. नन्द्?), long pepper.

नन्दकिन्, ई, m. ‘the possessor of Nandaka,’
an epithet of Kṛṣṇa-Viṣṇu.

नन्दथु, उस्, m. happiness, joy, felicity, pros-
perity.

नन्दन, अस्, आ, अम्, delighting, rejoicing, glad-
dening, pleasing, making glad or happy; (अस्), m.
‘rejoicing (a father),’ a son; ‘the rejoicer,’ an epi-
thet of Viṣṇu; an epithet of Śiva; a frog [cf. नन्-
दक]; a species of plant with a poisonous fruit,
(according to commentators also f.); N. of one of
Skanda's attendants; of a Siddha; of a Buddhist
deity, (also read नन्द); of the seventh of the nine
white Jaina Balas; of a mountain; of the twenty-
sixth year in a Jupiter cycle of sixty years; of a par-
ticular form of temple; (आ), f. ‘rejoicing (a mother),’
[]
a daughter; (अम्), n. a grove or garden frequented
by the gods, especially Indra's pleasure-ground or
elysium [cf. नान्दन]; N. of a sword (= असि-
रत्न, cf. नन्दक); N. of a species of the Dhṛti
metre (four times eighteen syllables); rejoicing,
gladdening; joy, felicity; [cf. Hib. naoidhin, ‘an
infant.’]
—नन्दन-कानन, अम्, n. ‘the divine
pleasure-grove,’ N. of a wood mentioned in the
Rasika-ramaṇa by Raghu-nātha.
—नन्दन-ज,
अम्, n. ‘produced in elysium,’ yellow sandal-wood.
—नन्दन-माला, f. ‘joy-causing garland,’ N. of a
garland worn by Kṛṣṇa.
—नन्दन-वन, अम्, n.
the pleasure-grove of the gods; [cf. नन्दन, n.]

नान्दन नान्दन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. नन्द् or
नन्दन), Ved. a pleasure-garden, a paradise,
elysium; [cf. नन्दन.]

नन्दनक, अस्, m. (at the end of a comp.)
a son.

नन्दयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, rejoicing, delighting,
making glad.

नन्दयन्त, अस्, ई, अम्, making happy, rejoicing,
delighting; (also read नन्दन्त.)
नन्दायनीय, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Bāṣkali.

नन्दि, इस्, m. (for नन्दी see under नन्द),
‘the happy one,’ epithet of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; N. of
an attendant of Śiva [cf. नन्दिन् and नन्दिकेश्वर];
N. of a man; of a Gandharva; (according to some
also) the speaker of the prologue or prelude to a
drama or one who pronounces the benediction, see
नान्दी, नान्दिन्; (इस्, इ), m. n. gambling, gaming;
(इस्), f. joy, delight, pleasure, happiness, prosperity,
welfare, (in these senses said to be also m. n.); Joy
personified as a daughter of Heaven or as the wife of
Kāma and mother of Harṣa.
—नन्दि-कुण्ड, अस्,
अम्, m. n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.
—नन्दि-
क्षेत्र, अम्, n., N. of a district frequented by the
gods.
—नन्दि-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain; [cf.
नन्दि-देवी.]
—नन्दिगिरि-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. ‘the
glory of Nandi-giri,’ N. of a work.
—नन्दि-
गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a prince of Kaśmīra.
—नन्दि-
ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a village (near the modern
Daulatābād, where Bharata resided during Rāma's
banishment).
—नन्दिग्राम-दर्शन, अम्, n.
‘description of the village Nandi-grāma,’ the twenty-
ninth chapter of the Pātāla-khaṇḍa of the Padma-
Purāṇa.
—नन्दि-घोष, अस्, m. cry of joy (=
वन्दि-घोष); the proclamation of a panegyrist
or herald; the chariot of Arjuna.
—नन्दि-तरु, उस्,
m. = धव, the tree Grislea Tomentosa.
—नन्दि-
तूर्य, अम्, n. a musical instrument played on joyful
occasions.
—नन्दि-देव, अस्, m., N. of a man; (ई), ? the
common N. of one of the loftiest Himalayan peaks.
—नन्दि-पुराण, अम्, n. ‘the Purāṇa of Nandi,’
N. of part of the Kedāra-kalpa.
—नन्दि-मुख =
नन्दी-मुख, a species of rice [cf. नदी-मुख];
N. of a man.
—नन्दिमुख-सुघोष, अस्, m., N.
of a man.
—नन्दिमुखसुघोषावदान (˚ष-
अव्˚), N. of a Buddhist work.
—नन्दि-रुद्र, अस्,
m., N. of Śiva in a joyful or serene form.
—नन्दि-
वर्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, increasing pleasure, promoting
happiness; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; a son [cf.
नन्दन]; a friend; the end of a half month,
i. e. the day of full moon or new moon; N. of a
particular form of temple (= नन्दिन्); N. of a
prince, son of Udāvasu or of Janaka, (in this sense
also read नन्दि-वर्ध); N. of a place.
—नन्दि-
वारलक, अस्, m. a species of fish.
—नन्दि-वृक्ष
or नन्दि-वृक्षक, अस्, m. the tree Cedrela Toona;
[cf. नन्दी-वृक्ष.]
—नन्दि-वेग, आस्, m. pl., N.
of a people.
—नन्दि-षेण or नन्दि-सेन, अस्, m.,
N. of one of Skanda's attendants.
—नन्दिषेणेश्वर
(˚ण-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Liṅga.
—नन्दी-मुख,
अस्, m. (नन्दी for नन्दि?), ‘having joy on the
face,’ an epithet of Śiva; a species of aquatic bird;
a species of rice [cf. नन्दि-मुख, नदी-मुख,
नान्दी-मुखी]; (आस्), m. pl. a class of manes or
deceased ancestors who are worshipped on festival
occasions [cf. नान्दी-मुख]; (ई), f. sleep (in which
the face shows joy), drowsiness; a species of the
Ati-śakvarī metre; (more correctly नान्दी-मुख.)
—नन्दीश (˚दि-ईश), अस्, m., N. of one of Śiva's
[]
attendants [cf. नन्दि, नन्दिन्]; N. of Śiva; a kind
of time in music (= नन्दीश्वर).
—नन्दीश्वर
(˚दि-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘lord of joy,’ an epithet of Śiva;
N. of Nandin, the leader of Śiva's attendants; N. of
one of Kuvera's attendants; N. of a place held sacred
by the Jainas; a kind of time in music (= नन्दीश).
—नन्दीश्वर-पुराण = नन्दि-पुराण.
—नन्-
दीश्वर-योगोपाख्यान (˚ग-उप्˚), अम्, n., N. of
the thirty-first and thirty-second chapters of the
Uttara-khaṇḍa of the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—नन्दीश्वरोत्-
पत्ति (˚दि-ईश्˚, ˚र-उत्˚), इस्, f. ‘the birth of Śiva,’
N. of the forty-second chapter of the Liṅga-Purāṇa.
—नन्द्य्-आवर्त, अस्, m. a particular kind of
diagram [cf. नन्दिकावर्त]; a sort of palace or
temple built in the shape of the above diagram or in
the form of a quadrangle without a western gate, (in
this sense also अम्, n.); a species of large fish; a
kind of tree; the shrub Tabernæmontana Corona-
ria (= तगर, = भगवद्-द्रुम), probably the
sacred fig-tree; a species of shell called so because
of its convolutions (आवर्त).
—नन्द्य्-उपपुराण,
अम्, n. = नन्दि-पुराण.
—नन्द्य्-उपाख्यान,
अम्, n. ‘the episode of Nandi,’ N. of the forty-fifth
to the fiftieth chapter of the Uttara-khaṇḍa of the
Śiva-Purāṇa.
नन्दी, f. See under नन्द and नन्दि.

नान्दी नान्दी, f. (fr. rt. नन्द्), joy, satis-
faction; prosperity; eulogium or praise of a deity,
or a prayer recited in benedictory verses at the open-
ing of a religious ceremony or of a drama, (generally
a kind of blessing pronounced as a prologue to a
Nāṭaka or play; cf. नन्दी.)
—नान्दी-कर, अस्,
m. the speaker of the benediction at the opening of
a drama; (also with the vowel ई made short, नान्दि-
कर.)
—नान्दी-निनाद, अस्, m. a shout of joy.
[]
—नान्दी-पट, अस्, m. = नान्दी-मुख, the lid or
cover of a well.
—नान्दी-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a
town in the East.
—नान्दीपुरक, अस्, &c., coming
from or relating to the town Nāndī-pura.
—नान्दी-
मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, (with पितरस् or पितृ-गणस्)
the class of manes of deceased progenitors to whom
the Nāndī-mukha Śrāddha is offered; (अम्), n. (with
or without श्राद्ध) a Śrāddha or commemorative
offering to the manes preliminary to any joyous
occasion, as initiation, marriage, &c., in which nine
balls of meat are offered to the deceased father,
paternal grandfather, and great-grandfather; to the
maternal grandfather, great-grandfather, and great-
great-grandfather; and to the mother, paternal grand-
mother, and paternal great-grandmother; (अस्), m. =
नान्दी-पट, the lid or cover of a well; (ई), f. a female
ancestor sharing in the above Śrāddha; a kind of grain
reckoned among the Ku-dhānyas; a kind of metre
consisting of four lines of fourteen syllables each;
[cf. नन्दी-मुख.]
—नान्दी-रव, अस्, m. a cry
of joy.
—नान्दी-वादिन्, ई, m. the speaker of the
prologue or introduction to a drama; a drummer,
one who beats a drum at festivals.
—नान्दी-श्राद्ध,
अम्, n. = नान्दी-मुखं श्राद्धम्, q. v.

नन्दिक, अस्, m. the Tūn tree (Cedrela Toona),
the wood of which resembles mahogany and is used
for furniture &c. [cf. नन्दी, नन्दी-वृक्ष]; N.
of one of Śiva's attendants; N. of a pupil of Śākya-
muni, chief of the village Uru-vilvā.
—नन्दिका-
चार्य-तन्त्र (˚क-आच्˚), N. of a medical work.
—नन्दिकावर्त (˚क-आव्˚), अस्, m. a kind of
diagram (= नन्द्य्-आवर्त); a species of plant.
—नन्दिकेश (˚क-ईश), अस्, m., N. of a temple or
holy place.
—नन्दिकेश-लिङ्ग, अम्, n., N. of the
thirty-ninth chapter of the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—नन्दि-
केश्वर (˚क-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of one of Śiva's chief
attendants [cf. नन्दिन्, नन्दि]; N. of an author.
—नन्दिकेश्वर-काशिका, f., N. of a Vedānta work
by Nandikeśvara treating of the first of Pāṇini's gram-
matical aphorisms as containing the dogmas of the Ve-
dānta belief.
—नन्दिकेश्वर-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of
a sacred bathing-place mentioned in the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—नन्दिकेश्वर-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of an Upa-
Purāṇa.
—नन्दिकेश्वर-संहिता, f., N. of a work
mentioned in the Tantra-sāra.
—नन्दिकेश्वरा-
भिषेक (˚र-अभ्˚), अस्, m., N. of the forty-third
and forty-fourth chapters of the Liṅga-Purāṇa.
—नन्दिकेश्वरोत्पत्ति (˚र-उत्˚), इस्, f., N. of the
twenty-first chapter of the Uttara-khaṇḍa of the
Śiva-Purāṇa.
नन्दीक नन्दीक, अस्, m. (?), a cock.

नान्दीक, अस्, m. a post in a door-way set up for
good luck; (also read as du. नान्दीकौ.)

नन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ (at the end of a comp.), rejoic-
ing, gladdening; happy, delighted; delighting in,
liking; making happy, gladdening; (ई), m. ‘rejoicing
(a father),’ a son; the speaker of the prelude or bene-
diction at the opening of a drama [cf. नान्दिन्]; N.
of several plants, the Indian fig-tree, Thespesia Popul-
neoides, Phaseolus Radiatus; N. of a particular form
of temple [cf. नन्दि-वर्धन]; N. of a being
attending on Śiva and (commonly) of the bull on
which he rides [cf. नन्दि, नन्दीश, नन्दिकेश्-
वर]; N. of a Buddhist saint and teacher; (इनी),
f. ‘rejoicing (a mother),’ a daughter; a husband's
sister (= ननान्दृ); holy basil (= तुलसी); Nar-
dostachys Jatamansi (= जटामांसि); a kind of per-
fume (= रेणुका); a fabulous cow, daughter of
Surabhi, related to the cow of plenty, and the property
of the sage Vasiṣṭha; an epithet or a form of Durgā;
an epithet of Gaṅgā or the Ganges; N. of one of
the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; of a place; of a
river (also called Vala-jā).
—नन्दिनी-तनय or
नन्दिनी-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Nandinī,’ epithet of
Vyāḍi.
—नन्दिनी-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred
bathing-place.

नान्दिन् नान्दिन्, ई, m. the speaker of the
benediction before the commencement of a play.

नन्द्य (fr. नन्द), Nom. P. नन्द्यति, &c., to
be glad, to rejoice.
नन्दलाल नन्दलाल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
नन्दीट नन्दीट, अस्, m. a bald-headed man.
नन्नम नन्नम (fr. rt. नम्) in कु-न्˚, q. v.

नन्नम्यमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.),
bending or bowing very low.

नानद नानद, अम्, n. (fr. rt. नद्), N. of a
Sāman; [cf. नानन्द.]

नानन्द नानन्द, अम्, n. (fr. rt. नन्द्), scil.
इन्द्रस्य, N. of a Sāman; [cf. नानद.]

नानर्दमान नानर्दमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the
Intens. of rt. नर्द्), sounding loudly, roaring lustily.

नानानम्, ind., Ved. = नाना, differently, sepa-
rately, &c.

नानान्द्र नानान्द्र, अस्, m. (fr. ननान्दृ),
a husband's sister's son, a sister-in-law's son.

नानुष्ठेय नानुष्ठेय (न-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
not to be performed, improper, unusual, not right.

नान्त नान्त (न-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, = अन्-अन्त,
endless.

नान्तरीयक नान्तरीयक (न-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
inseparable, invariably connected.

नान्त्र नान्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. rt. नम्), praise,
eulogy; [cf. नात्र.]
नान्दुक नान्दुक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
